A month on since its release, the dust has now settled on the Black Ops 1 and 2 ports on PS4 and PS5. The verdict: it's an immensely popular release that at last gives PlayStation users a way to play the game on modern systems. But it's clearly lacking in a few ways - with settings that fall far short of PC's best, and with ongoing online connectivity issues. Tom on task to investigate the highs and lows.
